population: Nonfinancial original annual filers in 2014-2020 from the historical SEC frame; original excluded IDs and all recent calibration/final reservations excluded.
sampling: All newly discovered SEC Item 1.03 proxy companies plus independent 10% background in the complement of the original 915 sampled companies. Original BRD certainty companies retain probability one. Original background companies in the extension frame and new companies use union pi=.1+.9*extension_pi, irrespective of outcome or acquisition phase.
scope: Automated issuer Chapter 7/11 disclosure evidence, not exhaustive court outcomes. No missing outcome becomes zero; continued original reporting required for negatives. No final evaluation rows are acquired or scored.
